ask_user./description: Pause the task and ask a human for missing information. Never invent the human answer.

read_file./description: Read a text file inside the Agent workspace and return its contents.
read_file./parameters/properties/path/description: The workspace-relative path to the file to read
read_file./parameters/properties/offset/descriptio: Skip this many Unicode characters, starting at zero. Use for large uploaded text references.
read_file./parameters/properties/limit/description: Read at most this many Unicode characters (1..4096); use 1024 for long attachments and advance offset until all required content is read.

list_files./description: List files and directories inside the Agent workspace.
list_files./parameters/properties/path/description: The workspace-relative directory path to list

write_file./description: Write text content to a file inside the Agent workspace.
write_file./parameters/properties/path/description: The workspace-relative path to the file to write

delete_file./description: Delete a single file inside the Agent workspace using the appropriate operating system command.
delete_file./parameters/properties/path/description: The workspace-relative path to the file to delete

fetch_url./description: Read a URL as bounded readable text. GitHub repository URLs return README via GitHub API without assuming a branch; HTML pages return main article Markdown. If the output says it was truncated or lacks a requested item, call again with contains set to that exact name or phrase. A failed or truncated result does not verify omitted facts; never claim it was re-checked unless a successful result contains the fact. HTTP errors fail. raw=true preserves raw content.
fetch_url./parameters/properties/raw/description: Return raw content instead of readable main text (default false).
fetch_url./parameters/properties/contains/descript: Optional exact name or phrase used to return bounded matching excerpts from the full readable page.

run_command./description: Run an executable directly (no shell) inside the Agent workspace. cwd is workspace-relative; outside paths are rejected. On Windows do not use shell builtins or Unix commands such as dir, mkdir, ls, rm. Use list_files, write_file (creates parent directories), delete_file and project_scaffold instead. For test evidence use run_test_suite.
run_command./parameters/properties/command/descripti: The command and arguments to run. Path arguments must stay inside the Agent workspace.
run_command./parameters/properties/artifacts_directo: In container mode, export regular files from /artifacts into this workspace directory without overwriting existing files.
run_command./parameters/properties/program_directory: For creating or updating a program, use its dedicated workspace directory. Registers new output before execution, tracks build success/failure, and reuses managed directories. Existing unmanaged directories require human adoption. Omit cwd with this option.

run_skill./description: Run a local registered Skill by name with structured inputs.
run_skill./parameters/properties/inputs/descriptio: Skill inputs matching the Skill input schema
run_skill./parameters/properties/program_directory: Dedicated managed program/output directory. Reuse the same directory for the same program; existing unknown directories are not adopted automatically.

manage_memory./description: Manage long-term semantic memories. Use this to correct, archive, supersede, or confirm memories when asked by the user.
manage_memory./parameters/properties/memory_id/descrip: The ID of the memory to modify (e.g., 123)
manage_memory./parameters/properties/confirm/descripti: Legacy metadata only; cannot authorize high-risk changes.
manage_memory./parameters/properties/approval_id/descr: One-use approval ID granted by the human via /approve; bound to identical operation arguments and session.
manage_memory./parameters/properties/superseded_by/des: ID of the new memory that supersedes this one (required for 'supersede' action).

edit_file./description: Edit an existing file by replacing a specific string. Use this carefully.
edit_file./parameters/properties/path/description: The workspace-relative path to the file
edit_file./parameters/properties/old_str/descripti: The exact string to be replaced
edit_file./parameters/properties/new_str/descripti: The string to replace it with

search_web./parameters/properties/max_results/descr: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

browse_webpage./description: Browse a webpage and return its text content.
browse_webpage./parameters/properties/url/description: The URL of the webpage to browse

analyze_image./description: Analyze an image using the vision model and return a description.
analyze_image./parameters/properties/image_path/descri: The workspace-relative path to the image file
analyze_image./parameters/properties/prompt/descriptio: Optional prompt or question about the image (default: 'Describe this image in detail.')

create_dynamic_tool./description: Stage an immutable Python tool proposal. It requires tests and human approval before activation; staging never executes code.
create_dynamic_tool./parameters/properties/name/description: The name of the tool (must be a valid Python identifier)
create_dynamic_tool./parameters/properties/code/description: The complete Python code for the tool.
create_dynamic_tool./parameters/properties/schema_json/descr: The JSON string representation of the tool's schema, strictly adhering to the OpenAI tool calling format.

desktop_tool./description: Use the connected desktop's allowlisted tools. Side effects require local human approval. No shell commands.
